text:
Anika (Partnerships): OK team, quick sync — CloudCo marketplace listing + joint launch cadence. Need to lock press embargo, co-branded landing, and asset handoffs by EOW. Who can own the press list?
Samir (GTM): I can own press list. I'll add partner PR contacts and our press agency. Need embargo date proposed.
CloudCo - Partner: +1. We prefer week of May 10 for partner outreach, but flexible. Can we target May 12 embargo?
Liam (Marketing): May 12 works. Question: are we doing a single co-announcement or staggered (catalog first, press later)?
Priya (Product): Recommend catalog (marketplace + docs) go live first, then press 24 hours after to avoid listing propagation issues.
Hannah (Engineering): We'll need final artifact by May 8 to verify listing and tests (runtime compatibility and billing hooks).
Anika (Partnerships): Proposed cadence: May 10 internal partner preview -> May 12 public catalog launch -> May 13 press/blog + partner blog cross-post. Does that align?
CloudCo - Partner: Yes, that cadence works for us. We have legal signoff on co-branding today.
Samir (GTM): I'll own embargo + press list. Liam, can you draft press release by May 7?
Liam (Marketing): Yep. I'll draft and post to #marketing-drafts. Need quotes from Product & Partner. Priya, please send a 2-sentence quote. CloudCo, can you provide partner quote?
Priya (Product): Sending quote now: "Redwood + CloudCo makes inference predictable at scale for enterprise apps."
CloudCo - Partner: "CloudCo and Redwood together give customers a simple path to run production LLMs with cloud-grade SLA."
Hannah (Engineering): For catalog validation I'll need 2 things: final container image tag and sample pricing metadata. Also, please confirm UTM/tracking scheme so telemetry maps back to campaign.
Anika (Partnerships): Good call. Samir — do we have UTM standard?
Samir (GTM): Use utm_source=cloudco, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=cloudco_redwood_launch. Add partner_id param for partner attribution.
Liam (Marketing): Adding to the PR checklist. Quick snippet for microsite CTA link: 
```
https://redwood.ai/marketplace/cloudco?utm_source=cloudco&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloudco_redwood_launch&partner_id=cloudco-42
```
Hannah (Engineering): Perfect. I'll run listing smoke tests against that link once the page is up.
Anika (Partnerships): Docs/landing ownership: Priya -> product overview + integration guide; Liam -> marketing landing + hero assets; CloudCo -> partner-specific screenshots and logos. Share assets by EOD May 6.
CloudCo - Partner: We'll upload logos and screenshots by May 5. Any constraints on formats? SVG preferred for logos.
Priya (Product): PDFs fine for screenshots but prefer 1920x1080 PNG for hero.
Samir (GTM): Also need partner one-pager for our sales teams and marketplace listing short description (<=160 chars). I'll compile.
Liam (Marketing): I'll produce hero and 160-char blurb. Draft blurb: "Run high-performance LLMs on CloudCo with Redwood Inference — predictable latency, lower cost, enterprise controls." Thoughts?
Priya (Product): Slight tweak: change "lower cost" -> "cost-optimized".
Liam (Marketing): Updated.
Hannah (Engineering): Quick note: Billing integration test window is May 9-10. We need sandbox account from CloudCo by May 8 to run tests.
CloudCo - Partner: We'll provision sandbox creds by May 7. Expect an email from our infra team.
Anika (Partnerships): Dependencies recap (small checklist):
- Press list & embargo owner: Samir (by May 6)
- PR draft: Liam (by May 7)
- Partner quotes: CloudCo (done)
- Product quote & docs: Priya (by May 6)
- Assets (logos/screenshots): CloudCo & Liam (by May 5-6)
- Final image tag + pricing metadata: Hannah (provide by May 8)
- Sandbox creds: CloudCo (by May 7)
- Listing live: May 12 -> Engineering verifies
- Press & blogs: May 13 (24h after listing)
Samir (GTM): I'll create embargo share with the press agency and ping legal for final review.
Liam (Marketing): Also planning social schedule + paid support. Will drop a calendar invite for creative review tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "CloudCo x Redwood Launch Creative Review" on 2026-05-04 10:00 PDT.
Priya (Product): One more ask — can Partnerships confirm co-marketing budget for paid social? Need number for paid schedule.
Anika (Partnerships): We're approved for $10k in co-marketing. Samir will allocate between paid and agency amplification.
Samir (GTM): Allocated $6k paid social, $4k agency.
Hannah (Engineering): Flag: If listing propagation hits a delay, fallback plan is to hold press and instead do partner blog spotlight only. Keep me posted on any listing errors.
Anika (Partnerships): Agreed. Let's aim for no surprises — check-ins daily next week. I'll run a 15-min standup Mon-Fri at 9:30am PT in this channel starting Monday.
CloudCo - Partner: Thanks everyone. We'll prioritize sandbox and asset handoff. Looking forward. :rocket:
Liam (Marketing): Thanks — I'll post the first draft by EOD tomorrow in #marketing-drafts. :memo:
